title: Japan GDP, July–September 2026 second preliminary (Cabinet Office, 08:50 JST) — the capex-revised growth print six days before the December Tankan
source: EST: esri.cao.go.jp/jp/sna/kouhyou/kouhyou_top.html (Cabinet Office ESRI quarterly GDP release schedule, Japanese page), fetched direct 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200, 11,979 bytes). Its quarterly-GDP table reads '2026年7-9月期（2次速報）' with the date cell '2026（令和8）年12月8日（火）' and 8時50分, the same row the first-preliminary entry japan-gdp-q3-prelim-2026-11-16 cites (first preliminary 2026-11-16, Oct-Dec first preliminary 2027-02-15). Filed estimate: market-events-data defines no confirmed source prefix for a Japanese statistics office, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-11-14
notes: PROPOSED during the boj-tankan-2026-12-14 interval-elapsed pulse (2026-11-14, D-30) and owned by that lane (one file per owner, #1717).
